rows.item: Monday 15 Feb 2027 closes two main attractions
rows.detail: Shanghai Museum (People's Square) is closed Mondays except public holidays. Yu Garden is closed Mondays except national holidays. 15 Feb 2027 is a Monday, so do these on 16–18 Feb.

rows.item: US entry is not a general visa-free tourist entry
rows.detail: The 240-hour transit rule requires an onward ticket to a third country or region, with a 10-day maximum. A normal sightseeing trip needs a Chinese L visa unless Hainan's 30-day rule applies. Verify with the embassy before booking anything.

rows.item: Yu Garden hours and price conflict across websites
rows.detail: Third-party sites show 8:30–17:00 and ¥40 (or ¥60 at Spring Festival). The official Yu Garden page shows 9:00–16:30 and ¥30 from 1 Dec to 31 Mar, plus ¥40 from 1 Apr to 30 Jun and 1 Sep to 30 Nov. The official page is used here.
publicholidaycalendar.com says China's Spring Festival holiday is 5–10 Feb 2027 (6 days). The official State Council notice says 5–13 Feb (9 days). The official notice is used here.

Third-party sites show Shanghai totals of 49, 50 or 51 starred restaurants and 11 or 12 two-star restaurants. The official release names 12 two-star restaurants (1 three-star). The 1-star count (38) is derived from the release (35 retained + 3 new).

Huaiyang Delights is 三月醉淮扬 on one site and 扬州宴 on another. Amazing Chinese Cuisine appears as 菁禧会, 菁禧荟 and 成隆行蟹王府. Imperial Treasure and Yu Bao Xuan are swapped on one site. Confirm names on the Michelin Guide site before booking.

rows.item: Shanghai Museum closed-day conflict between branches
rows.detail: An official notice for the East museum says closed Tuesdays (2024; the page was seen in search results and not opened directly). The People's Square notice says closed Mondays (Aug 2025, opened directly). Each branch needs its own check; the People's Square notice must be re-checked close to the trip.

rows.item: Hainan 30-day rule not checked for other provinces
rows.detail: The official Hainan page is verified. The nationwide 30-day list (where the US is reportedly NOT included) was not fetched from NIA.
